title: UI wave 2 U8: Sidebar title row and the hover switch in Settings (H, I)
description: Plan task U8. Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. review.note:
APPROVE (reviewer agent-272b, OpenCode; unconflicted -- I did not write U8). Judged U8's acceptance only; U10/T119, U5/T102 and U3/T100 hunks in the same files were set aside.

ACCEPTANCE RUN ON MY OWN SCRATCH BUILD (dist node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui2-u8-review/dist, port 1589, workers 1, retries 0):
- npx tsc --noEmit -p . -> exit 0.
- npx vitest run src/sidebarPreferences.test.ts src/palette.test.ts src/designTokens.test.ts -> 3 files, 26/26 pass.
- npx vite build -> exit 0.
- PREVIEW(8) tests/sidebar-selection.spec.ts, tests/layout.spec.ts, tests/housekeeping.spec.ts, tests/appearance.spec.ts, tests/features.spec.ts -> 40/40 PASS. This closes exactly the gap the worker disclosed (it never reran appearance or features after its one-line CSS fix, and features had never run). The two failures the worker saw -- notice.spec toast timing and the title padding above -- do NOT reproduce.
- The worker's declared flake (title 24px not 16px from the top) is fixed and the new layout case measures the title row within space-4 + 1px.

CODE READ (against plan U8): sidebarPreferences.ts matches the Interfaces line exactly -- SIDEBAR_KEY folio.workspace.sidebar, SidebarPreferences {width,pinned,hover}, defaults 270/true/true, per-field type fallback, try/catch both ways; App owns hoverReveal from readSidebarPreferences().hover and the Settings checkbox sets state and writes {...read, hover}; ProjectSidebar renders .sidebar-title-row with .project-switch + .sidebar-pin and the reveal focus effect targets .sidebar-title-row .sidebar-pin; no .sidebar .brand. Open question 1 is followed over the brief (title renames in place; nav back is the Projects tab) and the stop-and-ask condition it names was handled: the native harnesses were adapted and the smoke binary rebuilt. Harness diff is navigation-only (click(project-switch.textContent) -> click('Projects')), which is the correct adaptation.

NATIVE: viewed ui2-u8/native-plain/writing-light.png (sidebar starts with the project title 'Screens fixture', no Personal Word line, ends at the Settings row) and ui2-u8/native-plain/settings-light.png (General shows Reveal sidebar on hover, checked, after Palette and before Storage location). 20 PNGs present from the worker's run.

FINDING FILED SEPARATELY, NOT HELD AGAINST U8: after a fresh smoke rebuild, scripts/native-reliability.py --suite baseline AND --suite beta both fail with 'Attachments mirror file is missing after saving image project' (logs ui2-u8-review/native-baseline2.log, native-beta2.log). U8 touches no Rust and no asset code, and its harness change is navigation-only, so this is almost certainly not U8's; src-tauri/src/store.rs write_attachments gained the PDF mirror in U8's sibling task U18/T124, whose review (agent-f4ea) ran cargo and vitest but NOT native-reliability. I did not edit another task's files to prove attribution. This blocks Validation step 6 (U21), so I filed it as a board task. A first attempt before the rebuild failed with 'Diagnostic binary predates a D1 source input', i.e. stale binary, not product. BOUNDARIES: Chromium plus Apple WebKit screenshots only; no owner real-use proof. Status CLAIMED.
